prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A dynamic, high-contrast black and white photograph captures a group of contemporary dancers in mid-motion, arranged in a visually striking, symmetrical composition against a seamless white background. The dancers, all dressed in loose-fitting white shirts, black pants, and white sneakers, are frozen in various athletic poses, some crouched low to the ground, others leaping or reaching upward, creating a sense of explosive energy and fluidity. Each dancer holds or interacts with a black ball, which adds a graphic element and visual rhythm to the scene. The lighting is bright and even, eliminating shadows and emphasizing the crisp outlines of the figures, while the reflective floor subtly mirrors their movements, enhancing the sense of depth. The overall style is minimalist and modern, with a cinematic quality reminiscent of high-fashion editorial photography or avant-garde dance films. The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, capturing the full bodies of the dancers and emphasizing the choreography’s geometric precision and the interplay between stillness and motion.
